notes: Three new Control Panel themes: Vellum — bone paper, ink black and oxblood, light and roomy. Cobalt Works — blueprint steel, cobalt and signal orange, set entirely in a monospaced face. Ultraviolet — glass surfaces, violet to magenta, soft…

Each carries a different feel, not just a different palette: Vellum uses sentence-case labels and taller rows, Cobalt Works squares off every corner, Ultraviolet rounds them. None of that was possible until this week — those were fixed in…
Vellum is the first light theme. The interface was built dark-first, and it reads correctly on paper without a second set of rules.

All three failed the readability standard when first written, at ratios low enough to make footer text hard to read. Corrected, and the build now measures contrast on every theme rather than trusting that someone checked.
